business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Structural Drafting

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Luxembourg (Unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic code tradition with codified commercial law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg–China Double Taxation Agreement (1985, as amended)
Luxembourg–United States Double Taxation Agreement (1996, amended 2009 and 2018 protocol)
Belgium–Luxembourg Economic Union (BLEU)–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (2005)
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (ratified by Luxembourg in 2014)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing (consolidated, as last amended by the Law of 30 July 2021); Law of 13 January 2019 establishing the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE); Grand-Ducal Regulation of 23 January 2019 on RBE procedural rules; Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies as amended (Article 1015 et seq., SCSp regime introduced by the Law of 12 July 2013); CSSF Regulation No. 15/05 and CSSF Circular 19/732 on AML/CFT compliance; FATF Recommendations 10 and 24.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (post-ECJ Judgments C-37/20 and C-601/20: RBE access restricted to competent authorities and AML/CFT obliged entities; unrestricted public access abolished)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport of each ultimate beneficial owner, general partner and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Luxembourg is party to the Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / certificate of non-insolvency
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official commercial registry or competent court of domicile in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization where origin state is not a Hague party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Criminal record extract (police clearance certificate) for each individual UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police, judicial or interior authority of country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility invoice or bank statement, issue date within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility provider or regulated bank in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; alternatively notarized attestation of address

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming OECD-compliant beneficial ownership and banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relationship bank of the UBO / corporate partner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or authenticated bank statement (bank-notarized)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney for incorporation, RCS registration and RBE filing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of articles of association and registry extract for any corporate partner/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate UBO's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: RBE extract (Register of Beneficial Owners) for any corporate partner already registered in Luxembourg
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Direct administrative issuance; no apostille required for domestic Luxembourg documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all general partners, limited partners, UBOs and authorized representatives against the consolidated EU/UN financial sanctions list of the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists, Interpol notices, and international adverse-media databases; PEP identification under Article 2(1)(12) of the Law of 12 November 2004; enhanced due diligence mandatory for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions (FATF list) and politically exposed corporate structures; ongoing monitoring and re-screening of the client file required at least every 24 months and upon trigger events.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), online portal rcs.lbr.lu and administrative filing via guichet.lu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be drafted in Latin script; Luxembourgish, French, German or English denominations are admissible; non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, CJK, Arabic) require a statutory transliteration into Latin characters for RCS registration; the name must include the legal form suffix 'SCSp' or 'Société en commandite spéciale' in prescribed position and shall be distinctive, non-misleading and not contrary to public order.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: SCSp (where the entity is not an SCSp)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected or opposed by the RCS registrar: (i) file a corrected denomination through LBR within the active reservation window without additional nominal fee; (ii) submit written observations with the RCS registration desk; (iii) in case of formal refusal, introduce an appeal by petition before the commercial chamber of the Tribunal d'arrondissement de Luxembourg within 30 days of notification; the court may order the registrar to accept the denomination; legal basis: amended Law of 10 August 1915 and RCS administrative practice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible with limits: the SCSp must maintain a registered office ('siège social') in Luxembourg; this seat may be supplied by a licensed domiciliation agent, which is accepted for a non-licensed engineering CAD/BIM partnership; however, Luxembourg banks and payment service providers (including Wise) generally require a verifiable physical trading address, actual substance documentation, and access-to-account policies before onboarding; pure virtual office without operational footprint increases AML/KYC friction and may trigger extra bookkeeping duties.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated annual inspection probability 3–5%) for a non-regulated, non-licensed CAD/BIM outsourcing SCSp without public tenders; probability rises to approximately 15–20% where the SCSp obtains VAT registration, bids for EU/state procurement contracts, or becomes subject to CSSF desk reviews and AML/CFT audits.

Registration of the entity in the RCS (inscription au registre de commerce)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per RCS fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of constitutive act in the RESA (Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations)
RBE beneficial ownership declaration filing (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing fee per RBE regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translations of UBO dossier and statutory documents (English into French/German)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator accredited before Luxembourg courts

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of the UBO/notarization bundle in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority or consulate in country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing administrative/consular rate (approximately USD 10–20 per document)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and domiciliation service (first full year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for SCSp domiciliation packages

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC compliance screening subscription (PEP, sanctions, adverse media, OFAC/UN/EU database)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial compliance data provider (e.g., Refinitiv, World-Check, Dow Jones)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation agent administrative coordination and filing fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Luxembourg incorporation / corporate services firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per SCSp engagement agreement

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 on Commercial Companies, as amended, and the Law of 12 July 2013 establishing the Société en Commandite Spéciale (SCSp) (Articles 904-1 to 904-11)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Partnership Agreement (Convention de Société) filed via Form C and submitted to the RCS
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; contributions are freely determined in the partnership agreement; no escrow account requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the initial partnership agreement of the SCSp, as presented to this meeting, is hereby approved and adopted in its entirety. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the SCSp shall be established at [Address], Luxembourg City, within the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, and that the general partner is authorized to execute the lease or service agreement therefor. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed as manager (gérant) with full power to represent the SCSp, to open bank accounts, to engage service providers, and to execute all documents necessary for the registration with the Luxembourg Business Registers and the tax and social security administrations. All actions previously taken in connection herewith are hereby ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Legal counsel / Notary (notarization optional; mandatory only for real estate contributions)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and execute the SCSp partnership agreement (statuts/convention de société) containing corporate name, registered office address, capital contributions, classes of interests, general partner powers, manager appointment, profit-sharing, and tax election provisions. Execution by all partners; signatures may be private unless notarization is required.
required_dossiers: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Draft partnership agreement with SCSp provisions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS queries the partnership agreement, cure by filing an amended private deed or notarial rectification within 15 calendar days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Luxembourg Business Registers (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the cooperative/commercial registration application (Form C) and the executed partnership agreement to the RCS online via the LBR platform. Include the registered office consent and identification documents. Pay the official registration fee. Receive the RCS registration number and certificate of registration (extrait du registre).
required_dossiers: Registered office consent form / lease agreement
Identification documents of partners and appointed manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query or rejection, correct the identified formalities (name availability, registered office proof, signature legalization) and resubmit within 15 days; appeal to the Luxembourg District Court if the refusal persists.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Electronic Companies and Associations Bulletin (RESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Official Gazette – RESA (Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon RCS registration, the RCS automatically transmits the incorporation data to RESA for mandatory publication. Verify the published extract is accurate and monitor for the publication certificate, which is required for third-party enforcement.
required_dossiers: No separate filing – triggered by RCS registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of publication delay or error, contact the RCS to request a corrected extract; the SCSp is not opposable to third parties until publication is complete.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and VAT Filing Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT / ACD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SCSp for Luxembourg corporate income tax (IRC), municipal business tax (ICC) and, if applicable, VAT. File the VAT registration form using the RCS extract and estimated turnover. Obtain a Luxembourg VAT number if taxable supplies are made; otherwise declare exemption for outsourcing services.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AEDT queries the application, supply clarification on the deemed place of supply and client classification; retroactive registration may be applied, resulting in interest-only penalty if cured within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Security and Employer Registration (if hiring staff)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the SCSp will employ staff in Luxembourg, register as an employer with the CCSS within 8 days of hiring. Provide the RCS extract, manager mandate, and employee identification forms. For a pure offshore drafting service with no Luxembourg payroll, this step is optional.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late employer registration triggers administrative fines; cure by retroactive filing and payment of any separate social security contributions, typically without penalty if disclosed voluntarily.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial license required for pure CAD/BIM engineering drafting services under Luxembourg commercial law
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – commercial registration via the RCS suffices for offshore engineering design activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – office-based drafting activity does not trigger a full EIA or environmental registration
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process discharges; only municipal waste and e-waste handling rules apply under the Waste Management Act (Law of 21 March 2012), including proper disposal of IT equipment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate required for the registered office premises issued by the local commune (service d'incendie et de secours); structural load inspections apply only if heavy filing systems are installed; workplace safety clearance under the Luxembourg Labour Code (Art. L. 314-1 et seq.) ensures ergonomic workstations and adequate lighting.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (Luxembourg Inland Revenue) for direct tax and taxpayer matricule matters; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (Luxembourg Registration Duties, Estates and VAT Authority) for VAT and indirect tax matters. Official digital portal: guichet.lu and MyGuichet.lu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Luxembourg SCSp: (1) conclude the partnership deed and register with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register through a notarised or private deed via MyGuichet; (2) obtain the RCS registration number and the corporate matricule; (3) apply to the Administration des contributions directes for the national taxpayer identification number where a separate matricule is required; (4) submit the VAT registration application to the Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA before commencing taxable supplies using the official AEDT registration form; (5) if the entity is a foreign supplier not established in Luxembourg, register directly for a Luxembourg VAT number and appoint an accredited VAT fiscal representative where the supplier has no EU or EEA establishment and no OSS eligibility; (6) retain supporting evidence of the foreign taxable person status, intended taxable activities, expected turnover and place-of-supply rationale.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Luxembourg does not have a US-style check-the-box election. An SCSp is fiscally transparent by default for corporate income tax, municipal business tax and net wealth tax purposes. Under Article 175bis LIR, a Luxembourg partnership may validly elect, subject to applicable conditions, to be treated as a fully taxable Luxembourg resident corporation for income tax purposes; the election is binding for at least five taxable periods unless the Luxembourg tax administration accepts earlier termination. Hybrid mismatch and reverse-hybrid rules under Article 168ter LIR are mandatory and cannot be elected away; they apply to recharacterise a transparent SCSp only to the extent necessary to prevent double non-taxation, double deduction or deduction-without-inclusion outcomes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Luxembourg VAT Code and EU VAT Directives
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for small businesses established in Luxembourg; non-established foreign suppliers have no domestic registration threshold where taxable supplies are made in Luxembourg, unless the supply falls within the EU One-Stop-Shop or Import One-Stop-Shop regimes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, API-based clearance, or digital stamping for B2B VAT invoices as of the current regime. Electronic invoicing is accepted subject to authenticity, integrity and readability requirements; PEPPOL BIS 3.0 is accepted in the public procurement environment. VAT returns, recapitulative statements, Annex VIII filings and OSS returns must be filed electronically through MyGuichet or the Luxembourg VAT authority portal; no national mandatory e-invoice clearance repository applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported to non-EU destinations are zero-rated if the exporter retains proof that the goods physically left the EU. Engineering, CAD, BIM and structural drafting services supplied to a non-EU B2B customer are generally zero-rated or outside the scope of Luxembourg VAT because the place of supply is where the customer is established. The SCSp must retain sufficient documentary evidence of the customer's non-EU status, the contractual service description, and, where relevant, the actual export movement or foreign recipient's establishment details.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The AEDT may recharacterise zero-rated or outside-the-scope supplies as taxable at 17% Luxembourg VAT where the export or non-EU customer evidence is missing, false or insufficient. Associated input VAT is subject to partial or full clawback, unpaid VAT is collected with late-payment interest of 0.6% per month, and administrative fines may range from 10% to 200% of the tax due depending on culpability. Fraudulent zero-rating or VAT evasion may additionally trigger criminal penalties, including imprisonment and fines up to EUR 50,000 or more under Luxembourg fiscal criminal law. The standard assessment limitation period is five years, extended to ten years in cases of fraud or intentional concealment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL); banking prudential and conduct supervision delegated to the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) under the Law of 5 April 1993 on the financial sector, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Luxembourg is a full Eurozone member; the euro is completely convertible for current and capital account transactions. No exchange control approval, conversion quota, or beneficiary notification requirement applies to cross-border profit remittances or capital flows, subject only to EU and Luxembourg sanctions regulations and CSSF AML/CTF obligations. Partnership distributions from an SCSp are generally exempt from Luxembourg withholding tax; however, fees, interest, or royalties paid to non-residents may trigger domestic withholding at 15% or a treaty-reduced rate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory requirement to surrender, convert, or repatriate export proceeds within a fixed timeline. Invoices for civil-infrastructure CAD/BIM services may be settled in any currency and retained in foreign-currency accounts. Statistical reporting applies to the BCL Balance of Payments survey for entities meeting turnover and cross-border transaction thresholds; no mandatory conversion ratio exists.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for EEA-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) under PSD2 via passporting; a full Luxembourg banking auxiliary is not required. Non-EEA offshore EMIs are not acceptable for local IBAN or TARGET2 settlement and present legal uncertainty for corporate treasury. Wise Business can be used for operational disbursements but should be backed by a CSSF-supervised credit institution for capital escalation and high-value settlements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is permitted via CSSF-compliant video identification for the authorized signatories and the general partner. Physical presence may still be demanded by the bank's KYC policy when the ultimate beneficial ownership chain includes high-risk non-EU jurisdictions, or when the SCSp lacks a registered agent in Luxembourg. Where applicable, the registered agent must co-sign the application and verify the partnership's good standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through SCSp with multiple non-resident limited partners obscuring UBO identification
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Organizational chart, partnership deed, any registered-office agreement, notarized UBO declarations per the Law of 13 January 2019, passports and proof of residential address for every partner (or the general partner for dormant limited partners), plus a CSSF-compliant source-of-wealth questionnaire.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital escrow contribution exceeding EUR 25,000 without transparent source of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve-month bank statements of the contributing partner, signed capital contribution agreement, audited financial statements or corporate tax returns of the funder, and a documented source-of-funds declaration showing commercial viability of the injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border trade disbursements for BIM/CAD services lacking underlying invoice and contract evidence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master services agreement, itemized invoices, project scoping documents, IP assignment or non-disclosure undertakings, and annual financial statements of the contracting counterparty; also an EU sanctions check against all parties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low operational substance in Luxembourg (no employees, no physical office)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered office agreement with a Luxembourg service provider, an economic substance file, engagement letter of a local accountant or tax advisor, minutes of partner decisions held in Luxembourg, and evidence of local ultra-vires management mandates.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All injections must be routed via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for bank-to-bank) using an appropriate purpose code such as 'Direct Investment – Equity Capital' under the EU Balance of Payments classification. The beneficiary must be the SCSp's account name exactly as registered. For transfers within the EEA, SEPA Instant Credit Transfer is permissible for amounts below EUR 100,000; larger sums are cleared through TARGET2. Each contribution must be booked in the SCSp's statutory ledger with a corresponding partner capital record.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are executed through SWIFT MT103 with trade-related purpose codes, e.g., 'Engineering and professional services'. For larger infrastructure procurements, commercial documentary credits (MT700) or standby letters of credit (MT760) may be opened through a Luxembourg credit institution; these are cleared against presentation of conforming documents, usually through the beneficiary's confirming bank. SEPA Credit Transfer is the standard clearing rail for EUR-denominated vendor payments within the EU/EEA.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC foreign exchange outright forwards with variable tenors matched to trade invoices
Foreign exchange swaps (spot-to-forward combinations) for cash-flow hedging
Cross-currency interest rate swaps where long-term infrastructure payment streams create currency and interest-rate risk
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-convertible or restricted emerging-market currencies, subject to an underlying trade exposure and CSSF product-appropriateness rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RCS Annual Data Confirmation (confirmation annuelle des données RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation on the anniversary of RCS registration or within 30 days of the LBR electronic summons; must be performed at least once per calendar year via the e-RCS portal by the managing general partner.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines between EUR 500 and EUR 25,000 for breach of registration and confirmation duties; persistent default may lead to a court-ordered strike-off of the RCS registration and compulsory liquidation proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: RBE Annual Confirmation of Beneficial Owners (confirmation annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least once per calendar year from the date of the initial RBE declaration; updated confirmation due within 30 days of any transfer of partnership interests or change in the chain of control.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fines of EUR 1,250 to EUR 1,250,000 for false, incomplete, or omitted UBO declarations under Article 20 of the RBE Law; imprisonment of 8 days to 6 months for natural persons; confidentiality restrictions on the register may be lifted on application by third parties in case of persistent default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Accounts and Books of Account (internal preparation – SCSp exempt from RCS publication due to absence of legal personality)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No public filing with the RCS; books and annual accounts must be available for inspection by the Administration des contributions directes (ACD) upon request
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual accounts must be prepared within 6 months following the financial year-end; managing general partner must approve and sign the accounts; records retained for 7 years.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of EUR 500 to EUR 25,000 under the Luxembourg accounting law for failure to maintain proper books; tax authorities may apply default assessment; the managing general partner bears joint and several civil liability for accounting deficiencies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Partnership Annual Tax Declaration (transparent SCSp schedule for corporate income tax, municipal business tax, and net wealth tax attribution to partners)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) – Luxembourg Direct Tax Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March following the tax year for electronic filing; administrative extension to 31 December of the following year when filed through an approved tax adviser; no entity-level CIT or net wealth tax is due because the SCSp is fiscally transparent.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default assessment (taxation d'office) with late-payment interest at 0.6% per month; procedural fines of EUR 25 to EUR 25,000 under the General Tax Law; per-day coercive fines (astreinte) may be imposed; partners remain jointly and severally liable for their allocable share.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT Return and EU Recapitulative Statement (where the SCSp is VAT-registered for B2B engineering, CAD, and BIM services)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) – Luxembourg VAT Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly, quarterly, or annual VAT returns per the assigned filing cycle; annual reconciliation due by 31 January of the following year; EU recapitulative statements for cross-border B2B services due quarterly by the 20th day after the quarter.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of up to 10% of the VAT due with a EUR 20 minimum per month of delay; late-payment interest at 0.6% per month; criminal fines up to EUR 25,000 for concealment of taxable supplies; managing general partner may be held jointly liable for VAT debts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to an SCSp in Luxembourg because it lacks separate legal personality under the Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies. The mandatory audit regime of the Law of 19 December 2002 (applicable where two of three size criteria are exceeded: balance-sheet total over EUR 4.4 million, net turnover over EUR 8.8 million, or average headcount over 50) targets legal persons only. An audit becomes compulsory if (i) the limited partnership agreement expressly mandates a réviseur d'entreprises agréé, (ii) the SCSp is regulated by the CSSF as an investment fund or SIF, or (iii) the SCSp is a consolidated undertaking of an EU group subject to group audit thresholds. For an unregulated civil-infrastructure CAD/BIM outsourcing vehicle, statutory audit is elective.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the amended Law of 19 December 2002 on annual accounts of commercial companies (implementing EU Directive 2013/34/EU), supplemented by Articles 11-16 of the Luxembourg Code de Commerce; IFRS permitted on a voluntary and consolidated basis; for ISIC 7110 engineering services, revenue is recognised on a percentage-of-completion or time-based allocation consistent with Luxembourg GAAP, and tax accounting follows the Luxembourg Income Tax Law (LIR) for pass-through attribution to partners.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Article 4 of the Luxembourg Law of 13 January 2019 on the Register of Beneficial Owners, as amended, each beneficial owner must confirm at least once per year the accuracy of their RBE data. The managing general partner is responsible for initiating the annual confirmation through the LBR portal and must update the RBE declaration within 30 calendar days of any transfer of limited-partnership interests or any change in the indirect ownership chain. Annual confirmation must be performed regardless of whether the partners are non-resident; the register must ultimately identify all natural persons exercising control over the SCSp, disregarding intermediate entities where applicable.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Partners (Registre des associés) – maintained by the managing general partner at the registered office
Register of Managing Partners (Registre des gérants) – required where more than one general partner is appointed
Minute Book (Registre des procès-verbaux) – recording resolutions of the managing general partner and limited partners
Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE register) – held on file with annual confirmation records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 – 4,500 per annum (approx. EUR 1,400 – 4,200) for Luxembourg registered-office services, statutory mailbox, and annual compliance support from a fiduciary agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 – 10,000 (approx. EUR 3,200 – 9,200) for a voluntary agreed-upon audit or review by a Luxembourg réviseur d'entreprises agréé for a low-risk engineering service SCSp; USD 850 – 2,200 for a non-audit fiduciary compilation of annual accounts

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (aggregate Luxembourg CIT 17%, solidarity surcharge 7% on CIT, and municipal business tax at Luxembourg City rate; other communes may differ)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: SCSp is fiscally transparent and is not an entity-level CIT taxpayer; profits flow through to partners. For a taxable Luxembourg-resident corporate partner, the participation exemption applies to qualifying dividends and capital gains on participations of at least 10% or EUR 1.2 million acquisition cost held for 12 months; qualifying IP income benefits from an 80% exemption under the IP box, reducing the effective rate to approximately 4.99%; losses are recognised subject to the five-year carryforward limitation applied in this compliance model; treaty relief and the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive can further reduce effective withholding exposure.
